details: After enduring weeks of redemptions, US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) recorded modest net inflows on June 4-5. Bitcoin ETFs saw approximately $3.05 million in inflows, breaking a 13-day streak of outflows, while Ethereum ETFs attracted $19.30 million, primarily driven by BlackRock's ETHA fund.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs Post Brief Inflows Ending Outflow Streaks

details: A wallet associated with Ethereum co-founder Joseph Lubin transferred 110,000 ETH, valued at approximately $170 million, on June 6, 2026, after years of inactivity. This movement served as additional collateral for three Sky (formerly MakerDAO) vaults to safeguard a $259.05 million DAI debt position and mitigate liquidation risks.
title: Ethereum Co-founder Joseph Lubin Moves 110,000 ETH to Defend DAI Debt

details: On June 7, 2026, Bybit, a leading cryptocurrency exchange, introduced "Bybit IPO Express," enabling retail investors globally to participate in tokenized Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) of public equities, with SpaceX being the inaugural offering. This initiative aims to merge traditional capital markets with crypto infrastructure.
title: Bybit Launches IPO Express for Tokenized SpaceX Shares

details: The U.S. Treasury Department sanctioned Nobitex, Iran's largest crypto exchange, along with three other crypto platforms on June 6, 2026. The department accused these firms of providing significant support to the Iranian regime, including assisting the central bank and processing transactions for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, thereby evading U.S. sanctions.
title: U.S. Sanctions Iran's Largest Crypto Exchange Nobitex

details: Grayscale's Ethereum Staking Mini Trust ETF (NYSE:ETH) closed at approximately $15 on June 5, 2026, marking a 47% year-to-date loss from its starting price of $28 on December 31, 2025. An initial $10,000 investment in the fund at the beginning of the year is now worth about $5,328.
title: Grayscale Ethereum Staking ETF Down 47% Year-to-Date

details: As of June 7, 2026, the cryptocurrency market is exhibiting widespread short-term weakness, with most major cryptocurrencies reaching new lows by the end of the week. Bitcoin is trading near the significant psychological level of $60,000, indicating a clear decline in market enthusiasm and persistent selling pressure.
title: Crypto Market Experiences Broad Weakness, Bitcoin Nears $60K
